This blood test measures how many red blood cells, white blood cells, and platelets your child has. Each type of cell has an important job in the body. Red blood cells, also called RBCs 
These are the most common type of blood cells. Their main job is to carry oxygen. They pick up 
oxygen from the lungs when you breathe and carry it to the organs and tissues of the body.
